purpose: Persistent, append-only allocation ledger for bounded B-series authoring batches and immutable R-series implementation contracts. It allocates the current catalogue only; queued shards remain expansion work.

id_counters.rule: Never reuse, renumber, or replace an accepted B or R ID. Append new allocations using these counters only.

wave.resume_from: first batch whose state is not accepted; validate accepted IDs, paths, and provenance before dispatch
wave.recovery: If a batch fails, retain its IDs, mark it blocked or repairable, repair only its listed output paths, validate its contracts, then resume that same batch. Do not reallocate its R IDs.

dispatch_history.checkpoint: Validated catalogue/manifest unique IMP, B, and R IDs; all 12 catalogue contracts are allocated exactly once; SHARD-02 is the first queued chapter but remains ineligible while DEC-0004/GATE-0004 is unresolved. No contract allocation, counter advance, or accepted work overwrite occurred.

Expanded SHARD-02 into eight canonical, gate-retaining contracts (under its 250 limit), allocated each exactly once to B0007/B0008, and advanced only append-only counters. Validated unique IMP/B/R IDs, paths, provenance, dependencies, and asset assessments; no accepted work was overwritten.

Expanded SHARD-03 into six canonical, gate-retaining contracts (under its 250 limit), allocated each exactly once to B0009/B0010, and advanced append-only counters. Validated unique IMP/B/R IDs, paths, provenance, dependencies, and asset/audio assessments; no accepted work was overwritten.

Expanded SHARD-04 into six canonical gate-retaining contracts (under its 250 limit), allocated each exactly once to B0011/B0012, and created the sole final audit B0013 because no queued or ready P0 work remains. Validated append-only IDs, paths, provenance, dependencies, ownership, and asset/audio assessments; no accepted work was overwritten.
